title: Choose Bloom's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Baon Tiffin Carrier. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Baon Tiffin Carrier
options.lineage: stacked enamel lunch carriers (fiambrera) packed in Filipino kitchens
options.thesis: Her day is a stack of meals; every dose clips to the tier it belongs to.
materials: navy enamel rim as the one accent
options.viewport: Top: greeting and Week 24. The lifted top tier is the Next up card (big countdown, the why, a thumb-height Done). Below it, the rest of today stacks as tiers: breakfast, lunch, afternoon, dinner, bedtime.
options.risk: If the tiers get literal (handles, latches drawn in), it turns into a costume. It has to stay a clean app with tier-shaped grouping.

raised.raise: Next up shows one message only, the single next decision, with the time at monumental scale.
State is carried by form as well as color: solid = done, dashed = upcoming, struck = skipped, ringed = due now. It reads in the dark and for color-blind eyes.
Every time sits right-aligned in tabular numerals, the actual time beside the target, so lateness reads without words.

options.label: Keepsake Pregnancy Journal
options.lineage: clothbound baby and pregnancy memory books
options.thesis: Each care day is a dated journal page, filled in as she goes.
options.viewport: A dated page header, Next up as the open entry with its countdown, and today's lines below as the journal timeline.
options.risk: This is the literal reading of the brief: cream, serif and journal, which is where most runs in this category land.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Next up as an overhead sign: one decision, a monumental time, an arrow.
options.viewport: A yellow band with Caltrate · 1:42 PM at sign scale, and the timeline as the concourse of decisions ahead.
options.case: The clearest single action, but industrial yellow fights the tender, cream-blush brief and her night use.
options.risk: Reads like transit, not care. It breaks the pinned palette.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Doses as hairlines on one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: One rail across the day with each dose as a line.
options.case: Cold, scientific charcoal, opposite to a tender journal.
options.kept: State carried by line form (solid, dashed, struck), not color alone.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: The day as a timed tracklist.
options.viewport: Side A daytime, Side B after shift.
options.case: Charming, but nostalgia is not her world here.
options.kept: Running times right-aligned tight to the margin.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Time flows upward and length equals duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff of the day.
options.case: Too abstract to read one-handed at 1 AM.
options.kept: Spacing honest to real time gaps.

options.label: High-Density Modules
options.case: Density contradicts 'one clear action' and calm.
options.kept: A strict hairline border system instead of shadows.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.viewport: A grid of tiny dose cells.
options.case: Too busy; newsprint grays out her calm.
options.kept: Done items struck through, active one circled.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean medication-reminder app (Medisafe-style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A today list of pill cards with checkboxes and a progress ring.
canonCard.risk: Clinical and indistinguishable. Exactly the 'hospital app' the brief rejects.
